title: Alpine Macro王岩：政策发力，内地市场迎来轮动机会？
speaker: Yang Wang

segments.en: But obviously, local governments, they were very weak in their physical situation, commercial banks, the economy is weak, right?
segments.zh: 但显然，地方政府财政状况很弱，商业银行和经济也疲软，对吧？

segments.en: So in their face and very weak demand for credit. So this time around, you can see the central bank and central governments are putting a lot of, a lot more resources into supporting the economy.
segments.zh: 所以信贷需求非常疲软。这一次，你可以看到央行和中央政府投入了大量、更多的资源来支持经济。

segments.en: So I guess this is where the new momentum will come from. This is a direct state push.
segments.zh: 所以我认为新的动能将来源于此。这是直接的国家推动。

segments.en: And you know, I think the strategy I think earlier this year was always, I'm going to sell China by Korea.
segments.zh: 你知道，我认为今年早些时候的策略一直是，我要卖出中国、买入韩国。

segments.en: Is that trade you think reversing now in some ways?
segments.zh: 你认为这个交易现在在某些方面正在逆转吗？

segments.en: Well, I don't want to battle against the AI, right? So in all the stories, the numbers, the reports that you just talked about earlier, they are still quite powerful.
segments.zh: 嗯，我不想对抗AI，对吧？所以你之前谈到的所有故事、数字、报告，它们仍然相当强劲。

segments.en: But on top of that, obviously Taiwan, Korea, their stocks have gone through the roof. And China has really, and performed significantly.
segments.zh: 但除此之外，显然台湾、韩国的市场已经涨上天了。而中国确实，表现显著。

segments.en: So I think from, at least from a tactical point of view, the high-flying Taiwanese and the Korean market will likely take a pause.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，至少从战术角度来看，高歌猛进的台湾和韩国市场可能会暂停一下。

segments.en: And then the deeply depressed parts of EM, like China, Brazil, for example, they will do better going forward.
segments.zh: 然后新兴市场中深度受压的部分，比如中国、巴西，未来会表现更好。

segments.en: So this is, there is a mini rotation story. Okay.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个小型轮动的故事。好的。
